tldr: 台股大漲893點收復47K，台積電漲35元，晶片權值股領軍多頭回歸。
SEMI估2030半導體營收上看2兆美元，AI推升2026全球晶片營收創新高。
金管會公布2026年8項新制與IFRS17暫行措施，重塑壽險業版圖。

items.title_en: Taiwan stocks surge 893 points, reclaim 47,000 as chip rally returns
items.summary_zh: 台股收復47K、大漲893點 台積電扛盤 — 週五加權指數收在47,180.75點，上漲892.75點、漲幅1.93%，成功站回47,000點大關。台積電收2,460元、漲35元帶動盤面，上市成交金額逾1兆750億元，含上櫃合計逾1.34兆元。美股科技與半導體股隔夜強彈點火，資金重回AI權值股，市場交易熱度明顯升溫，多頭氣氛回穩。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's TAIEX jumped 892.75 points (+1.93%) Friday to close at 47,180.75, retaking the 47,000 level after an overnight US tech and semiconductor rebound. TSMC added NT$35 to NT$2,460 and anchored the index. Combined listed and OTC turnover topped NT$1.34 trillion, signalling a sharp pickup in trading appetite and renewed confidence in AI-linked large caps.

items.title_en: US chips power ahead overnight; TSMC ADR gains 3%
items.summary_zh: 美股科技領軍 費半揚3.14% 台積電ADR漲3% — 美股三大指數同步收紅，那斯達克漲1.69%、費城半導體指數勁揚3.14%。台積電ADR上漲約3%、收430.26美元；英特爾漲逾7%，美光、超微、閃迪同步走高。AI硬體與晶片股買盤回籠，為台股權值股提供正向指引，也支撐週五台北盤的多頭續攻氣勢。
items.summary_en: Wall Street's three main indexes closed higher, with the Nasdaq up 1.69% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rising 3.14%. TSMC's ADR climbed about 3% to $430.26, while Intel jumped over 7% and Micron, AMD and SanDisk posted mid-single-digit gains. The broad chip strength set a constructive tone for Taiwan large caps.

items.title_en: SEMI chief: Taiwan an AI hub, chip revenue seen hitting $2 trillion by 2030
items.summary_zh: SEMI總裁：台灣是AI重鎮 2030半導體衝2兆美元 — SEMICON Taiwan 2026登場，SEMI全球總裁暨執行長馬諾查指出，在AI驅動下，估2030年全球半導體營收上看2兆美元，台灣是全球關鍵AI重鎮。本屆展會吸引逾1,300家廠商參展創新高，聚焦先進封裝、矽光子與HBM等次世代技術，凸顯台灣在AI供應鏈與先進製程的戰略地位。
items.summary_en: At SEMICON Taiwan 2026, SEMI president and CEO Ajit Manocha said AI demand could push global semiconductor revenue to US$2 trillion by 2030, calling Taiwan a critical AI manufacturing hub. The show drew a record 1,300 exhibitors, spotlighting advanced packaging, silicon photonics and HBM as the next competitive battlegrounds.

items.title_en: Deloitte: global chip revenue to hit record $975bn in 2026, half from AI
items.summary_zh: 勤業眾信：2026全球半導體營收9,750億美元創高 AI佔半 — 勤業眾信《2026全球半導體產業展望》預估，今年全球半導體營收約9,750億美元、創歷史新高，其中生成式AI晶片營收近5,000億美元，約占整體晶片銷售一半。報告指出，前沿AI模型訓練算力以每年4~5倍成長，產業競爭由單一晶片效能，轉向ASIC、HBM與先進封裝等系統整合能力。
items.summary_en: Deloitte's 2026 Global Semiconductor Industry Outlook projects worldwide semiconductor revenue of about US$975 billion this year, a record, with generative-AI chips accounting for close to US$500 billion — roughly half of all chip sales. It underscores how AI compute demand, growing 4–5x a year, is reshaping the industry toward ASICs, HBM and advanced packaging.

items.title_en: FSC unveils eight new rules for 2026, ushering life-insurer transformation
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布2026年8項新制 壽險業迎大轉型 — 金管會公布明年上路的8項金融新制，涵蓋上市櫃公司須提前上傳股東會議事手冊及年報，以及壽險業的重大制度轉型。新制目標在提升資訊揭露透明度，並引導壽險業接軌新一代會計與清償能力規範，對業者的商品設計、資本配置與揭露作業將帶來調整壓力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has laid out eight regulatory changes taking effect in 2026, spanning earlier disclosure of shareholder-meeting handbooks and annual reports by listed companies and a major transition for the life-insurance sector. The package aims to lift transparency and align insurers with incoming accounting and solvency standards.

items.title_en: FSC offers three transitional measures to smooth IFRS 17 adoption
items.summary_zh: 金管會提3大暫行措施 助壽險業接軌IFRS17 — 金管會針對壽險業接軌IFRS17新一代保險合約會計準則，提出3項暫行措施，減緩準備金與資本適足的接軌衝擊。此舉可望降低帳列損益波動，並給予業者在商品組合與資產負債管理上的調整空間，協助壽險業平順過渡至新制，維持財務結構穩健。
items.summary_en: The FSC has rolled out three interim measures to help life insurers adopt IFRS 17, the new insurance-contract accounting standard, easing the transition on reserving and capital. The steps are intended to reduce volatility in reported results and give insurers room to adjust product mix and asset-liability management during the changeover.
items.source_url: https://insurance.vincent-chen.com/tw/助壽險業平順接軌ifrs17-金管會提3大暫行措施/

items.title_en: Insurers expand into wealth management as approvals reach ten firms
items.summary_zh: 保險業跨足財富管理 已10家獲金管會核准 — 截至2026年5月，保險業已有10家公司獲金管會核准辦理財富管理業務，為快速成長的高資產客群拓展服務管道。此趨勢呼應主管機關「亞洲資產管理中心」政策方向，放寬銀行與保險業對資產逾新台幣1億元客戶提供多元商品與諮詢，帶動高端理財市場競爭升溫與商品創新。
items.summary_en: As of May 2026, ten insurance companies have received FSC approval to conduct wealth-management business, widening channels for Taiwan's fast-growing high-net-worth segment. The trend reflects regulators' push under the Asian asset-management hub initiative to let banks and insurers serve clients with assets above NT$100 million through a broader product shelf.

items.title_en: Private banks court NT$100m clients with premium wealth platforms
items.summary_zh: 私銀搶億元客戶 高端理財平台競逐 — 台灣高資產客群競爭白熱化，星展頂級私人客戶門檻為月均總資產達新台幣1億元，永豐等同業則推出邀請制理財俱樂部，主打數位理財、專屬優惠與全球禮賓秘書服務。各行庫積極深化高淨值家族的手續費收入，並以跨境資產配置、傳承信託等服務強化黏著度與差異化。
items.summary_en: Competition for Taiwan's ultra-wealthy is intensifying, with DBS Treasures Private Client requiring monthly average total assets of NT$100 million and peers such as SinoPac rolling out invitation-only clubs offering digital advisory, preferential pricing and global concierge services. The race highlights banks' drive to deepen fee income from high-net-worth families.
